title: Chatbot embed build is not marked as a Shopify surface, so one event is dropped
evidence: widget-src/vite.config.chatbot.ts:18-21 define has no VITE_SHOPIFY_SURFACE (site-chat config has it at :27). Fixed 2026-11-25: the config defines the flag (US-15 AC2a). The bundle ships only in extensions/health-tool-widget (blocks/chatbot-embed.liquid, built by build:widget in the deploy), on both storefronts. An esbuild graph of src/chatbot-embed.tsx with the flag on keeps one flag read, trackProductEvent (src/lib/server-api.ts), with one caller, chat_thinking_opened (src/components/ChatMessageBubble.tsx:25); the other reads in server-api.ts and roadmap-data.ts (sendFeedback, trackABEvent, sendGuestReport) are tree-shaken out. widget-src/vite-configs.test.ts now lists the chatbot config as a Shopify surface: failed before the define, passes.
durability_check: vite-configs.test.ts pins the chatbot config's flag
